body_html:
An inner voice
chameleonlike
offer yourself to what
you encounter for
musical scoring
inhabits
punctuation and
line breaks
forming the tone,
the Poetry

in

  Zen

poems touch
  and change
translucent
intentions of
simple answers
in tendrils of attention
pointing to
fertile directions
#smallpoems
#foolingwithwords
Found Poem from Jane Hirshfield
